kind: single paired exploratory workload, not replicated causal experiment
selection_basis: native cached model catalog inspected; same current workhorse root for both
image_tokens: not exposed; count calls, outputs and retry/failure separately
coding_price_basis: hypothetical Standard API-equivalent, not subscription usage or actual charge
cost_formula: sum by model of uncached input, cached input, cache writes if reported, and billable output; do not double count reasoning if included in output
objective_check_groups: local imagery loads and alt text
subjective_review: blind labels, same 0-5 rubric: visual hierarchy, identity/art direction, typography/spacing, responsive composition, professional credibility; all scores evidence-backed; no causal or general savings claims
limitations: same-host other tasks and model load uncontrolled
native CLI may differ from desktop runtime
image costs omitted from monetary subtotal
max concurrency includes all descendants; actual native control behavior recorded
